El Cenizo Mayor Carina Hernandez and Rio Bravo Mayor Laura Padilla, both reelected on Tuesday, November 3, 2026, are laying out what they want to get done in their upcoming terms — and both put their communities' young people at the center of it.

For El Cenizo, Hernandez said the focus is cleaning up the city and creating a place for children. "Our youth need something to do, and our city needs to be clean," she said, according to KGNS, adding that the city's main focus is "cleaning up our city and doing something for our youth."

In Rio Bravo, Padilla said her priority is adding a city park — a safe place where families can gather and children can play. "I want to leave behind a place that people are proud of," she said, according to KGNS.

Both mayors thanked voters for their support and called for more residents — especially young people — to get involved in their cities. Hernandez said her administration is "going to be working very hard for them in the coming year," according to KGNS, while Padilla urged residents to show up and speak up about what is happening in Rio Bravo.

Webb Watch 956 will keep following both cities as the new terms get underway.

Sources: KGNS.

title: El Cenizo and Rio Bravo Mayors Outline Priorities for New Terms
